answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the plume of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The hollow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the yarrow.
